    StartersAhmad's Sunday devilled eggsHalved eggs piped with a mayo, mustard and sweet relish filling, hot sauce, paprikaHow to make it8 eggs3 tbsp mayonnaise1 tsp yellow mustard1 tbsp sweet relish1 dash hot sauce1 tsp smoked paprikaBoil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel.Halve and whip the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, relish and hot sauce.Pipe back and dust with paprika.Big Mama's ham hock braised greensKale or collards braised for hours with smoked ham hock and garlicHow to make it1 smoked ham hock1.5 L water1 brown onion3 garlic cloves1 pinch chilli flakes2 bunches of kale2 tbsp cider vinegarSimmer the hock in water with the sliced onion, garlic and chilli flakes.Strip the stems from the kale and chop. Add and braise gently.Pick the meat off the hock and stir it back in.Finish with the vinegar and serve in bowls with plenty of pot liquor.Big Mama's pan cornbread, honey butterThe cornbread in the cast iron panHow to make itAs written, serves 4Golden buttermilk cornbread baked in a smoking hot cast iron pan so the edges crisp, cut in wedges with whipped honey butter.Put 20g butter in a 25cm cast iron pan and heat in a 220°C oven for 10 minutes.Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar and half a tsp salt.Stir in 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter until just combined.Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes.Beat 80g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt.Candied yams with toasted pecansAhmad says it all starts with Sunday.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsSunday fried chickenButtermilk brined chicken, double dredged and fried in cast ironHow to make it1.5kg chicken pieces500ml buttermilk2 tbsp hot sauce300g plain flour2 tsp smoked paprika1 tbsp salt2 L vegetable oilBrine the chicken overnight in the buttermilk and hot sauce.Season the flour with paprika and salt and dredge the chicken twice.Fry in the oil in a cast iron pan at 165°C in batches until 74°C at the bone.Drain on a rack.Big Mama's baked mac and cheeseThe dish everyone fights overHow to make itAs written, serves 4Macaroni baked in a custard of eggs, evaporated milk and three cheeses until set, with a golden crust of sharp cheddar on top.Boil 500g macaroni for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain.Whisk 2 eggs with a 375ml tin of evaporated milk, 250ml milk, 60g melted butter, 1 tsp mustard powder, salt and pepper.Toss the pasta with 300g grated sharp cheddar and 100g grated mozzarella, then the custard.Tip into a buttered dish, top with 100g more cheddar and bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until set and golden.SweetsPeach cobblerSpiced cooked peaches under a soft biscuit toppingHow to make it6 peaches120g butter80g brown sugar1 tsp ground cinnamon1 pinch nutmeg200g self-raising flour150ml full cream milk1 L vanilla ice creamCook the sliced peaches with a third of the butter, the sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.Tip into a dish.Rub the rest of the butter into the flour, add the milk and drop over.Bake at 190°C.Serve with ice cream.DrinksBig Mama's sweet tea lemonadeSweet black tea mixed with fresh lemonadeHow to make it6 black tea bags1 L boiling water1 pinch bicarb soda160g caster sugar4 lemons500ml cold water1 bunch mint1 bag iceSteep the tea bags in the boiling water with the bicarb for 5 minutes.Stir in half the sugar while hot and cool.Stir the lemon juice with the rest of the sugar and cold water.Mix both in a big jug with ice, lemon wheels and mint, and pour.Fresh-squeezed limeadePoured for the kids' table, Ahmad first.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
